text:
sophia: Heads-up — seeing regressions in EU canary after runtime/quant rollout. Proposing a temporary SDK exemption (pin) for eu-canary so we can hotpatch without affecting hosted traffic. Need ops + QA signoff. :warning:

deploy-bot: [automated] pinlist-scan: affected targets: eu-canary (model: llama3-qv2, runtime: runtime-3.1-q), suggested action: add SDK-exempt: sdk@2.8.1 to eu-canary pinlist. CI failures detected: 3/10 smoke tests.

mike: can you paste the failing stack or a minimal repro? is this kernel OOM or operator mismatch?

sophia: quick tail of the failing canary pod logs:
```
ERROR: attention_kernel: unsupported instruction for quantized path
Traceback (most recent recent call last):
  File "/app/serve/main.py", line 212, in handle_request
    out = runtime.run(model, inputs)
  File "/opt/runtime/kernels/quant.py", line 88, in run
    raise RuntimeError("unsupported kernel opcode: fused_attn_v2")
RuntimeError: unsupported kernel opcode: fused_attn_v2
```

alice: looks like the SDK shim in 2.8.2 removed a compatibility fallback we relied on. 2.8.1 still has the fallback. Quant kernels in the eu cluster are using the newer fused_attn path after the runtime upgrade.

ben: fwiw, we already have a quick precedent for temporary SDK exemptions during kernel rollouts. Agree with pinning 2.8.1 on eu-canary until we either patch runtime or backport shim.

tara: +1 but we need a clear change window and rollback plan for compliance. When would you do the pin/unpin and what's the smoke checklist?

sophia: propose schedule: pin now (short), hotpatch build + canary smoke at 02:00-02:30 UTC, expand to staged hosts at 02:45 if smoke green, unpin at 06:00 UTC if no regression. Rollback command in runbook: `deploy-bot rollback eu-canary --to sdk@2.8.1` and unpin: `/deploy pinlist remove eu-canary sdk-exempt:sdk@2.8.1` if patch fixes.

qa-bot: canary test summary (latest run):
- token_latency_smoke: FAIL (p95 increased 120ms)
- generation_consistency: FAIL (divergent logits in 2 tests)
- basic_api_surface: PASS
link: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/778234

mike: +1 from infra, can run hotpatch. If smoke fails again, we do immediate rollback and open an incident. Keep the rollback flag handy.

deploy-bot: action queued: apply pinlist entry -> channel=eu-canary, reason="kernel-compat regression", entry="sdk-exempt:sdk@2.8.1", requested_by=sophia, runbook_ref=/runbooks/eu-canary-sdk-exempt.md

alice: I'll prepare a small shim backport branch and target a 02:15 build. Will post PR and image tags here. Also add note to release notes: "temporary sdk exemption applied to eu-canary to mitigate quant kernel regression".

sophia: thanks — once deploy-bot confirms pin applied we'll kick off the 02:00 smoke run. tagging @mike @tara for ops/approval. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [completed] pinlist updated for eu-canary -> sdk-exempt:sdk@2.8.1 (id=pin-20240321-01) by sophia at 1715004460

ben: leaving a checkbox here: [ ] docs updated [ ] smoke green [ ] rollback plan validated

tara: compliance note: record change window in change-log and fyi to security. I'll do that after the hotpatch.

sophia: closing loop — starting hotpatch build now, will report back with canary results. If anyone sees unexpected traffic impact ping me directly.
